exercises.question: I ________ this book three times already.
exercises.explanation: Use present perfect with 'already' for an unfinished time period up to now.

exercises.question: By the end of this month, she ________ her training course.
exercises.explanation: Future perfect: will have + past participle for completion before a future point.

exercises.question: They ________ for two hours when the bus finally arrived.
exercises.explanation: Past perfect continuous shows duration before another past event.
